name: Wario and the Tower of Garlic
summary: A short episode featuring Wario, its structure is loosely based off a mix of Wario Land 4 and Antonblast. You won't be grabbing things but you sure will be going at a fast pace exploring levels and collecting treasures of all kind while you climb up the Tower of Garlic... and who knows, there might be something special at the top...
